head: Dayclipse app: sunrise, golden hour and moon phase tracker
dek: Dayclipse: Sun & Moon Tracker is a $4.99 app that shows sunrise, sunset, golden hour, blue hour and moon phases for any place, and works offline. It was #29 among paid Weather apps on the US App Store on 21 November.
details: It also shows twilight times on a daily timeline, moonrise and moonset, a lunar calendar, an AR sky view with a live compass and a planner with a time slider for photos. City search works offline without GPS, and the calculations run on the phone; the listing notes they assume a flat horizon and don't count buildings, hills or weather. It came out on 31 October, added iPhone Duo support on 8 November and is made by Akila Mendis. The listing shows no in-app purchases.
where: iPhone and iPad (also Apple silicon Macs), App Store, $4.99
means: If you plan photos or walks around sunset or the moon, this app shows the times and the sun's direction without a subscription.
todo: Check the App Store page's screenshots and device list before paying; for mountains or tall buildings, allow for the earlier sunset the app can't see.
